messages_body:
Hi Priyom and team,

Thanks for offering to run the demo next week. Procurement here at Acme flagged that we need to complete vendor onboarding items before any live demo with internal data. Specifically: a signed NDA, our vendor onboarding form, and the security questionnaire filled out. I've attached the onboarding form and questionnaire to this email.

Can we pause scheduling the demo until those are complete? If possible, please send an NDA for signature and we'll route internally. If it's helpful, procurement prefers a two-week buffer so we can finish reviews and legal sign-off.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
---
Attachment: Acme_vendor_onboarding_form.docx (form)
Attachment: Acme_security_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the forms. We can absolutely wait until the NDA and questionnaire are complete. I'm looping in Marissa (demo engineer) and Rishi (CS lead) so they can plan availability.

I've attached a standard Redwood NDA (Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf) — please feel free to route via DocuSign or let me know if your legal team needs edits. In the meantime, can you share the procurement contact who will own the onboarding? Also, if you have a preferred date range after sign-off, send it over and we'll tentatively block time.

Proposed windows if you need rough availability:
- Tue 2026-04-28 09:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 2026-04-29 13:00-15:00 PT
- Thu 2026-04-30 10:00-12:00 PT

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142
---
Attachment: Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf (PDF)
Hi all,

Procurement here — Tom from Acme Procurement. We received the NDA and the onboarding materials. A couple quick notes:
- We prefer DocuSign for signature. Please send.
- We will need a copy of your latest SOC 2 report; if you can provide a redacted version or an SSAE attestation, that speeds review.
- We'll assign an owner to the questionnaire and generally expect this to take ~10 business days.

If it's okay with Redwood, let's tentatively move the demo to the week of 2026-04-27 and I'll confirm exact slots once internal review is complete.

Tom Campbell
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
procurement@acme-corp.com
Tom / Samantha —

Thanks Tom. I'll send a DocuSign link for the NDA this afternoon and is attaching a link to our SOC 2 summary in case procurement wants to review immediately. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/soc2-summary (publicly accessible to Acme).

Marking the demo tentatively for the week of 2026-04-27 as requested. Marissa / Rishi — can you confirm availability for the week of 04/27? If procurement moves faster we can try to keep an earlier slot, but we should assume sign-off will take about 10 business days.

I'll follow up once DocuSign is complete.

Thanks,
Priyom
---
Related link: https://www.docusign.com/ACME-Redwood-NDA
Priyom / Samantha —

I'm available for any of the proposed windows the week of 04/27. If you prefer a morning slot for the demo I'll take the 09:00-11:00 PT block. Also, can we get a short pre-demo checklist? I like to run a 15-minute tech-check 24 hours before the customer-facing demo to validate access and environment.

Short checklist idea:
- Confirm attendee list & roles
- Confirm demo environment & sample prompts/data
- Confirm recording permissions
- Provide meeting dial-in + backup link

Will prepare a one-page runbook and share to the drive folder.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Thanks — that works for us. We'll aim for a morning slot the week of 04/27, pending DocuSign and procurement confirmation.

Please send the DocuSign link and any SOC 2/attestation documents; once procurement confirms we'll send a calendar invite with the final time and include the 15-minute tech-check 24 hours prior.

Appreciate the coordination — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corp
